commentary: Sweden's 0.82% GDP growth in 2024 — the weakest in 5 years — provides fiscal backdrop to today's parliamentary activity. The Riksrevisionen agricultural climate finding (HD01MJU21) implies need for increased public investment at a time of constrained budgetary space. Sweden's elevated unemployment (8.69%) vs Nordic peers creates political pressure but also a labour pool for police expansion (HD03237 paid training). Denmark's 3.48% GDP growth highlights the fiscal gap that limits Sweden's climate transition spending relative to its primary Nordic comparator.
source: World Bank Open Data API, SCB, BRÅ, HD01MJU21, HD03237
